subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should this be handled first as hosted Molty deployment/stored-state repair, or is there a reachable OpenClaw UI/gateway source path that still emits dotted full Anthropic ids from Brain & Keys?
rationale: The hosted screenshots prove a user-facing blocker, but current main's normal picker and gateway patch path use canonical ids; only a hosted owner can inspect the deployed payload, stored workspace state, and service boundary.

options.title: Verify and repair hosted Molty first
options.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request path and stored model override for this workspace, migrate stale dotted ids, and redeploy or refresh the hosted catalog if needed.

options.title: Add source regression if reachable
options.body: If hosted Molty uses this source path, add a focused UI/gateway regression that prevents labels or full dotted Anthropic ids from being stored or sent.

options.title: Route outside this repo
options.body: If usemolty.com owns this behavior entirely outside OpenClaw, keep the issue as hosted support tracking until recovery is proven.

recommendation.title: Verify and repair hosted Molty first
recommendation.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request path and stored model override for this workspace, migrate stale dotted ids, and redeploy or refresh the hosted catalog if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses Anthropic model catalog support and gateway session model persistence, both with recent merged history from this owner signal.
